questions.question: Explain two different forms of Christian worship.

points.text: 1) Liturgical worship follows a set structure with formal prayers, readings and sacraments. The Catholic Mass is an example — it has a fixed order including the Kyrie, Gloria, readings, Eucharistic prayer and Holy Communion. 2) Non-liturgical worship is more spontaneous and informal. Baptist and Pentecostal services often include modern worship songs, extemporary prayer and a sermon, without a fix

questions.question: "Liturgical worship is better than non-liturgical worship." Evaluate this statement.

points.text: Some Christians prefer liturgical worship because it connects them to centuries of tradition, provides structure and reverence, and follows Jesus' instruction to "do this in remembrance of me" at the Last Supper. Others prefer non-liturgical worship because it feels more personal and authentic, allows the Holy Spirit to guide the service, and uses contemporary language that speaks to modern people
